verdict.rationale: Drata documents a Policy Center, and its API lets you create policies and create and list policy versions, so policy management with versioning is a first-party capability. The rest of the story is not shown in the evidence. missing for 10: lawyer-grade template library, in-app policy editor, approval workflow, per-employee policy acceptance tracking, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, policies come from a lawyer-grade template library with an editor, versioning, approvals, and per-employee acceptance tracking
